_note: Pre-July 2021 the entity was OU Medicine Inc.; merged with OU College of Medicine faculty practice and University Hospitals Authority on July 1, 2021 to form OU Health.

moodys.citation_text: Moody's downgraded OU Health from Baa3 to Ba2 in March 2022 — implying Baa3 was the prior rating held entering 2020-12-31. Confirmed via in-window downgrade record.

sp.citation_text: Not separately verified. S&P rated OU Health in BBB- range consistent with Moody's Baa3 peer rating. _warning: not independently confirmed.

fitch.citation_text: OU Medicine/OU Health not rated by Fitch in 2020-2022 per public record. NR.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Projected FY2022 cash flow materially below prior expectations due to escalating labor costs; reliance on financing to avoid further liquidity decline and potential covenant breach. Two-notch downgrade.
OU Health obtained $150M additional financing in May 2022 to bolster liquidity following Moody's Ba2 downgrade.

sp.citation_text: Inferred concurrent downgrade by S&P from BBB- to BB+ on parallel rationale. _warning: not independently confirmed.

outcome_class_rationale: Moody's two-notch downgrade Baa3 -> Ba2 (March 2022), crossing the IG/HY threshold — material credit deterioration in-window. This is an unusually negative outcome for the 2020-2022 cohort. OU Health is one of the rare hospitals where COVID/CARES did NOT prevent rating deterioration because integration costs and labor inflation overwhelmed federal relief.

operating_metrics_fy2020.citation_text: OU Medicine 2020 operating revenue ~$1.1B based on pre-merger scale; pre-merger entity had weaker liquidity already (covenant breach concerns). _warning: pre-merger financials inferred from Moody's Baa3 peer-typical levels.

ma_events_2021_2022.counterparty: OU College of Medicine faculty practice + University Hospitals Authority and Trust
ma_events_2021_2022.rationale: Formal merger of OU Medicine, OU College of Medicine faculty practice, and University Hospitals Authority and Trust to form OU Health — Oklahoma's first integrated academic health system. Integration costs contributed to subsequent Moody's downgrade.
$150M additional financing to address liquidity; raised leverage at already weak credit.
